ware_as_published: coins from beyond the Roman frontier (Aksumite aes of Aphilas; silver of Rudrasena III, Western Kshatrapas)
quote: An aes coin of King Aphilas ... and a silver coin of Rudrasena III of the Kshatrapas of Western India ... are the first numismatic evidence of contact between Berenike and regions beyond Rome's imperial frontiers.
note: Sidebotham's own inference (p.202): given the volume of South Asian finds at Berenike, the near-absence of South Asian coins 'may reveal something of the nature of this trade ... that it was one based more upon barter than upon purchase/sale in coined money.' This supports our finding that coins do not mark ports, from the opposite direction.
